report.summary: The report generally relies on the DRHP excerpts accurately, but three tags are problematic: (1) the claim that the box-pushing technique allows construction without traffic disruption is unsupported; (2) the tag to page 12 for the 57% revenue share is wrong-source (correct is page 67); (3) the claimed explicit warning about loss of Indian Railways on page 12 is unsupported. Additionally, the derivation of the 33% revenue decline is untagged. These issues should be corrected or re-sourced before finalizing.

untagged_claims.sentence: Revenue declined from ₹90.21 crore in FY2015 to ₹60.53 crore in FY2018 — a drop of about 33% over four years.
untagged_claims.suggestion: Should be tagged with source (page 27). Add citation for the derived percentage.
